asked.item: Export gave slides.zip instead of MP4

verdict.reason: The help pages explain that the Slideshow toggle controls ZIP vs MP4 output and give the steps to re-export as MP4.

steps.text: With the "Slideshow" toggle ON, export gives a ZIP file of individual slide images, and with it OFF, export gives an MP4 video file.
Open the visual in the editor and turn OFF the "Slideshow" toggle.
Click "Export" in the top right corner and wait for rendering to finish.
Click "Download" to save the MP4 file.
